release_slices.name: Storefront checkout cart preservation hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Keep an eligible tenant-store product order and its totals in checkout when an unrelated service-booking capability is unavailable.
release_slices.purpose: Keep an eligible tenant-store product order and its totals in checkout when an unrelated service-booking capability is unavailable.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Uses line-type-aware Storefront cart cleanup so product carts require product-cart and checkout capability while service lines require booking capability. Guest draft, DGFY checkout resume, quote, stock, payment review, tenant, and order-submission contracts remain unchanged.
included_features: Capability-aware preservation of product checkout carts
Independent fail-closed handling for service booking carts
Guest and DGFY-account regression coverage for the tenant-store checkout condition
excluded_features: Payment routing, PayMongo, QR Ph, billing, settlement, or fee changes
Tenant authorization or DGFY membership changes
Catalog, stock, quote, price, fulfillment, or order-submission API changes
Unrelated local inventory, CSV import, error-handler, and POS work outside this release
release_slices.owner_attribution: BabyBaBab owner-authorized hotfix and production deployment
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: The hotfix changes when Storefront cart state is discarded. A regression could retain a cart after its relevant checkout capability is revoked or still erase a valid cart during guest or DGFY-account checkout.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: Tenant-store product cart retention during checkout
evidence_covering_regression_risk: Unit tests cover guest and DGFY-account product carts when booking is unavailable, product checkout revocation, service booking preservation, and service booking revocation.

release_slices.name: POS shift-open refresh context hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: After a successful POS Open Shift action, immediately show the new active shift instead of leaving legacy/admin users stuck on the Open Shift modal.
release_slices.purpose: After a successful POS Open Shift action, immediately show the new active shift instead of leaving legacy/admin users stuck on the Open Shift modal.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Passes the exact selected terminal and resolved terminal-location context into the post-success POS operational refresh for both terminal unlock and in-session Open Shift flows. Backend authorization and shift lookup stay strict by terminal, cashier, and location.
included_features: Post-open shift refresh uses the exact terminal id used for the successful mutation
Post-open shift refresh uses the exact resolved terminal registry location
Contract test prevents regressing to stale location refresh after a successful shift open
excluded_features: Backend POS authorization, permissions, compliance gates, idempotency, or location-scope weakening
Payment routing, PayMongo, QR Ph, billing, settlement, or fee changes
Tenant identity, DGFY membership, invite, or account-linking changes
Unrelated local backend inventory, CSV import, and error-handler edits from the dirty checkout

release_slices.regression_warning_summary: The hotfix changes frontend refresh timing and scope after POS shift open. A regression could keep the modal stuck after success, show the wrong shift context, or hide a real shift-open failure behind stale UI state.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: POS Open Shift modal close behavior
Terminal unlock flow that opens a shift
